visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One swap Helper for partition
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The same three-line swap is written out three times in partition, with a different temporary name each time. Write one swap function with pointers. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A swap helper removes the repeated lines and the invented temporary names. partition now reads as the algorithm: move small elements forward, then put the pivot in place.
